integrity: Proof given in RESULT.md; deterministic-seed numerical and algebraic checks reproducible with verify_uniform_ritz.py; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric positive definite input, iid Gaussian sketches, an adversarial starting vector permitted after drawing the sketch, exact arithmetic; injective exact probability only in dimension two. title: Undersampling surjectivity and a two-mode beta law for Gaussian-sketched Ritz values
